title: Unified Observability for Retail Logistics
business: Logistics providers managing distributed microservices for real-time inventory tracking.
problem: Fragmented visibility across disparate compute nodes leads to delayed incident detection and prolonged resolution times during peak order processing.
solution: Azure Monitor centralizes telemetry by ingesting metrics, logs, and traces from diverse infrastructure components into a unified workspace, enabling cross-resource correlation and proactive alerting.
steps: Enable diagnostic settings on compute resources to stream logs to a Log Analytics workspace.
Configure metric alerts based on resource utilization thresholds to identify performance degradation.
Implement distributed tracing to visualize request flows across microservices.
Create workbooks to aggregate and visualize operational health data for stakeholders.
outcome: Reduced mean time to detection (MTTD) through centralized alerting and improved operational transparency across the logistics fleet.
limitation: Data ingestion volume directly impacts operational costs; users must monitor data ingestion rates and implement sampling or filtering to prevent unexpected expenses.
